__comment__: crypto_live.json — Grafana dashboard definition. Export from the Grafana UI and paste here.
__instructions__: Build the dashboard in the Grafana UI first, then export it via:
Dashboard -> Share -> Export -> Save to file
and replace this placeholder with the exported JSON.
1. Live Price Chart  — time-series panel showing real-time close prices for all symbols.
2. Moving Averages   — overlay SMA and EMA lines on the price chart.
3. Volatility Gauge  — bar gauge or stat panel showing current volatility per symbol.
4. Anomaly Markers   — scatter overlay or annotation on the price chart marking anomaly events.
5. Anomaly Count 24h — single-stat or table panel counting anomalies per symbol today.
Alert rules to configure (in Grafana Alerting):
- Alert when anomaly_count in last 15 minutes > threshold (e.g., 5).
- Alert when price changes by more than X% in a 1-minute window.
